import os
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != 2]
        if len(cols) >= 2:
            for c in range(min(cols), max(cols)+1):
                if grid[r][c] == 2: out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 2]
        if len(rows) >= 2:
            for r in range(min(rows), max(rows)+1):
                if grid[r][c] == 2: out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
test=[[2]*30 for _ in range(12)]
for r,c in [(0,10),(0,28),(2,18)]: test[r][c]=0
out=__import__('runpy').run_path(str(p))['transform'](test)
